summary: Iter9 testing covered all 8 requested backend behaviors (DELETE notifications, GET /billing/next-invoice + 403 path, POST /billing/admin/run-monthly + 403 path, GET /pros/<id> bookings field, GET /pros/<proId>/bookings, fee_log.due_at stamping, Standard-tier delayed push, Pro-tier instant push via Mongo plan_tier flip) and 5 frontend behaviors (Clear-all button, Next-invoice card, badge pills, weekly calendar with prev/next, plan-benefit copy). 10/10 backend tests PASS. Core frontend flows verified.

issues: 'Verified' badge did not appear in the body for pro@test.com — Licensed and Insured DID appear. Likely the pro_profiles.is_verified flag is not set in seed for this pro, not a UI bug. Confirm via DB if intended.
No 'Verified' text seen in profile card — same likely cause: pro_profiles flag not set. Visual pill styling could not be verified through DOM scrape but pro-cal-prev/next testids exist on /pros page.

verified_behaviors: DELETE /api/notifications → 200 {message:'Notifications cleared', deleted:N}; subsequent GET returns []
GET /api/billing/next-invoice (pro) → amount, fee_count, due_at ISO ending T00:00:00+00:00 on the 25th (future), cycle_start
Quote accept stamps fee_log.due_at on next 25th and increments fee_count by exactly 1
Standard pro receives NO instant new_job_match notification within 4s of /api/jobs POST
Pro-tier pro (plan_tier flipped to 'pro' via Mongo) receives new_job_match within ~1s
Frontend: bell panel opens with [data-testid=notification-panel], Clear-all button has red color (rgb(193,70,85)), clicking it zeroes unread_count
Frontend: /billing shows [data-testid=next-invoice-card] with €94.00 / 'Due on June 25 · 12 fees' / Pay-now button [data-testid=next-invoice-pay-now] when fee_count>0
Frontend: /pros/<pro_user_id> has [data-testid=pro-cal-prev] and [data-testid=pro-cal-next] confirming new DatedAvailabilityMatrix renders
action_items: Confirm whether pro@test.com's pro_profile is intended to have is_verified=true; if so, seed needs to set the flag so the Verified badge pill shows on both /settings and /pros/<id>.

(Cosmetic, optional) Translation copy 'Instant job alerts — 15-minute head start' was not found on the landing homepage — it likely lives on the /upgrade or pricing page, which was not crawled. Worth a quick visual confirm in EN/DE/TR/ES.
critical_code_review_comments: push_routes.py: STANDARD_DELAY_SECONDS uses asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget for delayed pushes. In a multi-worker / restart scenario, scheduled tasks vanish — acceptable for MVP but flag for production (use Celery / APScheduler / Mongo-backed queue).

billing_routes.py admin/run-monthly: when a pro has invoiced fees but also receives new pending fees after the run, the pro_profile.monthly_fees field is NOT recomputed — only happens on Stripe-paid path. Minor: invoiced fees still count toward outstanding when paying via Stripe (pay-outstanding only queries status='pending'), so the invoiced ones could be skipped. Verify intentional.
pro_routes.py: GET /pros/{id} now does 4 sequential Mongo round-trips per request (user, reviews+homeowners loop, availability, bookings, saved). Consider $lookup/aggregation for hot path.
